text: alex: starting a small config-only rollout now for tenant isolation + routing limits. quietwindow 23:00-01:00 UTC. no model changes, just routing/batch/timeouts. deploybot: Deploy initiated by alex. change_id=ci-8808, mode=CONFIG_ONLY, target=canary(5%), window=2026-03-23T23:00Z..2026-03-24T01:00Z. auto-rollback=enabled. sanjay: quick context — what routing policy is changing? alex: switching default route from 'fast'->'cost-optim' for free-tier traffic under high-concurrency. new config sets per-tenant rate cap 120rps -> 60rps, per-tenant burst 200->80, and batch_max_tokens=512->256. maria: noted. any timeout changes? alex: yes. idle_kv_ttl=120s->60s, req_timeout=12s->10s. this trims p99 tails. tina: are we pinning any versions or fallbacks? alex: no model pins. runtime remains same. fallback policy updated: if route errors then fallback to region-secondary + thin-batch profile. opsbot: Checklist: observability hooks enabled, smoke test (generate 50 small requests), canary ramp schedule (5% -> 20% in 30m), alert thresholds (error rate >1.5% or p99 latency +20%). sanjay: add note — watch KV cache pressure after ttl drop. can we enable temp kv-cache-metrics? alex: yes flipping kv-cache debug metrics for 1h. deploybot: Canary ramp to 5% complete. smoke tests passed (0 errors, avg latency 180ms). maria: I see slight increase in tail latencies in a node group (nodegroup-east-2). holding ramp. alex: holding ramp; will rerun targeted smoke: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference/test -d '{"prompt":"x"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer test'` (run from east-2). opsbot: Observability: nodegroup-east-2 p99 spiked 40% during batch flush, kv eviction rate +++ logged. recommended: revert idle_kv_ttl only for east-2 or increase batch_max_tokens to 384 as workaround. tina: prefer targeted revert to avoid full rollback. alex: agree. action: pin east-2 to old ttl (120s) via config patch, keep global changes. deploybot: Applying patch to east-2 TTL. patch_id=ci-8808-e2. maria: re-run smoke on east-2. smoke tests ok now (p99 within baseline). sanjay: monitoring for 45m. if error rate >1% or new p99 +10% vs baseline then rollback full config. alex: documenting release notes: "Config-only: tenant rate/burst limits reduced; batch_max_tokens reduced; idle_kv_ttl shortened (east-2 exception); request timeout minor decrease; fallback routing tightened." opsbot: Release notes recorded in changelog: https://internal.redwood/infer/changelog/ci-8808. deploybot: Canary ramp to 20% complete. final observation window 30m starting now. tina: thumbs up. maria: if green after window, we'll promote out of quietwindow at 01:10Z. alex: thanks team. will follow up with post-deploy metrics and the short rollback play if thresholds breach.
